endorsements.name: Vladimir Ivanov
endorsements.label: Web Application Firewalls: Analysis of Detection Logic
endorsements.description: The presentation will highlight the core of Web Application Firewall (WAF): detection logic, with an accent on regular expressions detection mechanism. The security of 6 trending opensource WAFs (OWASP CRS 2,3 - ModSecurity, Comodo WAF, PHPIDS, QuickDefense, Libinjection) will be called into question.
